result.summary: The 2023 mission-style text ("Our Products Fuel Modern Life", "best-in-class producer", "protecting our communities and the environment") and the "Our Guiding Principles" link were removed. The 2024 version replaces them with business facts and metrics ("~10,000 Employees", refinery and ethanol rankings) plus a "$77 million generated for charities" item and emissions-target progress, shifting emphasis from stated values to description.
